ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENTmadeasofthe 5th day of June, 2024 (this “Agreement") by and between 170 EAST 83RD STREET OWNER LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Douglaston Development, 7 Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Douglaston Development, 7 Penn Plaza, Suite 600, New York, New York 10001 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer, and their respective successors and assigns, each, a "Party” and, collectively, the “Parties"). RECITALS: A.( Owneris theownerinfeetitleofcertainlandknown as170East83rdStreet,New York, New York and identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “Tax Map") as Block 1511, Lot 33, which is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (the “Owner Land"; the building and improvements thereon, together with any future replacements, additions, or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to this Agreement, collectively, the “Owner Building"; the Owner Land and the Owner Building, collectively, the "OwnerPremises"). B. Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land known as 175 East 82nd Street, New York, New York and identified on the Tax Map as Block 1511,Lot 31,which is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (the “Developer Land"). C. Developer intends to construct a new building on the Developer Land (said new building, together with any Rebuilding (hereinafter defined) thereof, collectively, the “Developer Building"; the Developer Land and the Developer Building, collectively, the “Developer Premises"). D. The Developer Building will contain more Floor Area (hereinafter defined) than would be permitted on the Developer Premises if the Developer Land were considered as a single "zoning lot”under the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter defined). E． The Owner Land, if considered as a separate zoning lot, generates certain Development Rights (hereinafter defined) in excess of the Owner Development Rights (hereinafter defined). F. Prior to March 8, 2024, the Owner Land and the Developer Land were a single tax lot and a single “zoning lot" (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the Zoning Resolution and this Agreement, the “Zoning Lot") pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. G. The Parties have executed a Confirmatory Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated as of the date hereof (the “Declaration"), which is being recorded simultaneously herewith, to confirm the existence of the Zoning Lot. H.
